tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Audit one URL: fetch it as 16 AI and search crawlers plus curl and a browser, check robots.txt, structured data, answer-first content, freshness, hreflang and llms.txt. Returns a Markdown report with findings and fixes. language: report language code (en, de, ja, …).

tools.name: audit_sitemap
tools.description: Audit up to 10 pages listed in a sitemap or sitemap index. Returns one summary line per page plus the full report of every page with findings. Needs an API key.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Explain a finding id (e.g. access.blocked, robots.disallowed, schema.software_no_offers) in the given language: what it means, why it matters for AI search and how to fix it.

tools.name: compare_urls
tools.description: Audit 2 or 3 URLs (yours and competitors') and compare them side by side: score, P1/P2/P3 counts, blocked crawlers, llms.txt, structured data, text without JavaScript. Needs an API key.

tools.name: watch_site
tools.description: Add a URL to the account's scheduled monitoring (freq: daily or weekly). The owner gets an email when a check finds a new P1 problem or the score drops by 10 or more. Needs an API key; adding the same URL again only changes the frequency.

tools.name: list_watched_sites
tools.description: List the URLs this account monitors, with the frequency, last score and last check time. Needs an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_url, watch_site, list_watched_sites · Private data: audit_sitemap, compare_urls, watch_site, list_watched_sites · Public sink: watch_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_url, watch_site, list_watched_sites · Private data: audit_sitemap, compare_urls, watch_site, list_watched_sites · Public sink: watch_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
